name: Blessed Padding raises mail armor and cuts area damage (#1817)
contract: Blessed Padding rank 2 (301360) promises +100% Armor contribution from mail items and -20% damage taken from area attacks. The mail chest 1065932 carries 2248 authored armor; on this level-60 realm mod-coa-content-scaling's ItemBudgetScaler rewrites it at startup (required level 80 resolves the WotLK era, item level 307 is the RAID_PINNACLE tier, whose band 259-284 -> 87-96 (WotLK 55-60) maps it to item level 96), so its effective armor is round(2248 * 96/307) = 703, and learning the talent must add about that much armor on top of the unmodified total.

steps.label: Let spawn AI and level scaling settle
Blessed Padding doubles the mail chest's armor
